title: 第21章 时代变了佛祖也得与时俱进第22章 满屋鬼气冲天佛爷要送你上西天
content_zh:
负一楼停车场。
悟德从西装口袋里掏出车钥匙，随手按了一下。
“嘀嘀——”
不远处，一辆黑色保时捷帕拉梅拉的车灯闪了两下。
陈邪的脚步钉在了原地。
他扭过头，上上下下把悟德打量了三遍。
阿玛尼定制西装，金丝眼镜，锃亮的皮鞋，再加上这辆保时捷。
这特么是和尚？
“老德啊……”
陈邪咂了咂嘴，指了指那辆车。
“你这排面……怎么看都不像你们佛宗弟子该有的样子。”
悟德拉开车门，一条腿迈进去，坐得稳稳当当。
“基操而已。”
“走吧，早去早回。”
陈邪拉开副驾驶的门坐进去。
真皮座椅，屁股一挨上去，整个人都陷了进去。
舒服。
悟德单手打着方向盘，车子滑出停车场。
陈邪扫了一眼车内的配置，又看了看悟德。
“老德，我就想问一句。”

“你们上林禅宗，现在都这么世俗了？”
“开豪车，穿名牌，喝红酒。”
“你们方丈知道吗？”
悟德推了推金丝眼镜。
“时代变了，佛祖也得与时俱进。”
陈邪被这话噎了一下。
好家伙。
他算是服了。
这和尚要是还俗去做生意，绝对能在商场上杀出一片天。
“那你这车多少钱买的？”陈邪问了个很实际的问题。
“贫僧不记得了。”
“少来，你绝对记得。”
悟德没正面回答，反而来了一句：“陈邪，你知道我为什么选上林禅宗吗？”
“为啥？”
“因为上林禅宗不禁酒肉，不禁财色，不禁杀生。”
“贫僧觉得，很合适。”
陈邪沉默了两秒。
“你这哪是出家，你这是享家。”
“阿了个佛，你说笑了。”
两人一路扯皮，车子在城区的快速路上飞驰。
content_en:
Parking lot on the first floor.
Wu De took out the car key from his suit pocket and pressed it casually.
"Didi——"
Not far away, the headlights of a black Porsche Panamera flashed twice.
Chen Xie's footsteps were frozen in place.
He turned his head and looked Wu De up and down three times.
Armani custom-made suit, gold-rimmed glasses, shiny leather shoes, plus this Porsche.
What the hell is this a monk?
"Old man..."
Chen Xie smacked his lips and pointed at the car.
"Your face... doesn't look like what you Buddhist disciples should look like."
Wudela opened the door, stepped in with one leg, and sat firmly.
"It's just basic sex."
"Let's go, go early and come back early."
Chen Xie opened the passenger door and got in.
The leather seats make your whole body sink into them as soon as your butt touches them.
Comfortable.
Wu De turned the steering wheel with one hand and the car slid out of the parking lot.
Chen Xie glanced at the configuration in the car and then at Wude.
"Lao De, I just want to ask a question."
"Shanglin Zen Sect, are you so worldly now?"
"Driving luxury cars, wearing designer brands, and drinking red wine."
"Does your abbot know?"
Wu De pushed up his gold-rimmed glasses.
"Times have changed, and Buddha must also keep pace with the times."
Chen Xie choked at these words.
Good guy.
He was finally convinced.
If this monk returned to secular life and started doing business, he would definitely be able to make a name for himself in the shopping mall.
"Then how much did you pay for this car?" Chen Xie asked a very practical question.
"The poor monk doesn't remember."
"Come on, you will definitely remember."
Wu De did not answer directly, but instead said: "Chen Xie, do you know why I chose Lin Chan Sect?"
"Why?"
"Because the Shanglin Zen Sect does not prohibit wine and meat, wealth and sex, and killing."
"The poor monk thinks it's very suitable."
Chen Xie was silent for two seconds.
"You are not a monk, you are enjoying the family."
"Oh my God, you are joking."
The two of them were arguing all the way, and the car was speeding on the urban expressway.
